question: How should the app send messages?

choices.label: No notifications — app does not send messages
choices.hint: No email or SMS messages are sent.

choices.label: Test — write them down, send nothing
choices.hint: The whole flow runs and every message is recorded, so nothing reaches a real person while you build.

choices.label: Resend — sandbox sender
choices.hint: Real sending with no domain set up. Uses onboarding@resend.dev, which only delivers to the address that owns the Resend account.

fields.label: Resend API key
fields.hint: resend.com → API Keys → Create. A send-only key is enough.

fields.label: Sender address
fields.hint: Resend's own sandbox sender. Leave it as it is until you have verified a domain.

choices.label: Resend — your own domain
choices.hint: Sends to anyone. Needs a domain verified at resend.com/domains first, or every send is refused.

fields.label: Sender address
fields.hint: Must be at a domain that is verified in Resend.

choices.label: Twilio — SMS
choices.hint: Text messages. Numbers are stored in E.164: +94771234567.

fields.label: Account SID
fields.hint: console.twilio.com, at the top of the page.

fields.label: Sending number
fields.hint: Phone Numbers → Manage. +15005550006 is Twilio's magic test number.

choices.label: SendGrid — email
choices.hint: High-volume transactional email. A free tier, and what most companies already have.

fields.label: API key
fields.hint: Settings → API Keys, with Mail Send permission. It starts with SG. and is shown once.

fields.label: From address
fields.hint: A verified sender, or an address on a domain you authenticated in SendGrid. An unverified one is silently dropped.

choices.label: Mailgun — email
choices.hint: Transactional email with strong EU hosting. Sends from your own domain.

fields.label: API key
fields.hint: Dashboard → API Keys → your sending key.

fields.label: Sending domain
fields.hint: The domain you verified in Mailgun, not your website's domain.

fields.label: Region
fields.hint: 'eu' or 'us'. The wrong one authenticates and then sends nothing.

fields.label: From address
fields.hint: An address on the sending domain above.
